blockers.summary: An Obsolete WorkUnit can retain a dispatched and terminal Run even though Obsolete means never executed.
blockers.required_fix: Reject retained Runs or execution history on an Obsolete WorkUnit at the aggregate boundary, while retaining valid never-dispatched branches; add a regression case with an otherwise valid terminal Run on an obsolete node.

blockers.summary: A failed terminal WorkUnit can cite another WorkUnit's immutable failure Observation, Artifact or GateResult as its own blocking cause.
blockers.required_fix: Reconcile blocking-cause facts to the failing WorkUnit's exact relevant subject/owner and GateResult key, rejecting ambiguous or foreign facts; cover foreign-unit Observation, Artifact and GateResult while retaining legitimate failure paths.

blockers.summary: Cancelled or failed primary Runs without a submitted result are required to have a run-conclusion Observation.
blockers.required_fix: Distinguish submitted/succeeded primary results from failed or cancelled unsubmitted execution; require an exact terminal report and applicable immutable failure/cancellation evidence for negative cases without inventing a run-conclusion. Add an in-flight
